on_the_pod: setup re-checks the artifact against the pod's files (require_on_pod)

stop_conditions: the sample complete: every task's first candidate, then second candidates of the refused tasks only
the runner's soft stop and hard deadline from the accepted price (watchdog)
a generation failure: the group is incomplete, the session ends RUN_FAILED with every finished episode sealed
a deterministic failure repeating the previous paid attempt's signature: no new resource until diagnosed (session_prechecks.same_failure_gate)
provider or billing state unknown: nothing created; reconcile and tear down
an L40S out-of-memory: the run fails; an A100 needs the measured OOM and a separate authorization
recovery: identity-bound sealed shards on the volume (generation_driver.run_group, sealed every 50 records or 300 s); a replacement session -- a new run with a new one-use artifact -- regenerates nothing sealed and runs only each label's unsealed tasks; candidate k uses seed_base + k
cleanup_and_reconciliation: the launcher's terminal path deletes the pod and confirms it gone with the provider, secures tool_pilot_hybrid (shards, tool_session.json, telemetry.jsonl) and closes out; a session that created a resource and records no closeout cost is an unknown, and every later issue refuses until it is reconciled (study_engineering.envelope)
telemetry: per engine invocation (telemetry.jsonl): wall time, nvidia-smi peak memory.used and utilization, the engine's model-load and KV-cache lines, preemption lines, run_battery's summary (engine init seconds, output tokens/s) and its engine metrics (--engine-metrics: preemptions, KV-cache usage peaks, token counters, where the installed vLLM reports them)
per turn (sealed records): prompt and generated tokens, TTFT, seconds
outputs: measurement records only by default (sealed episodes, census, telemetry, report); reuse in formal data is a separate maintainer decision
